status: independent lower-opening mask candidate, no Editor or runtime acceptance
mergedImagePackaging: Canonical original v1 PNG reused to avoid a second lossy white-matte/unmatte conversion in ag-psd; decoded merged-image RGBA also matches v1 exactly.

geometry.algorithm: For source pixel center y+0.5 < cy, alpha=255 across the full canvas width; otherwise copy the exact alpha byte from existing OpeningMask. Nontransparent RGB is white; transparent RGB is zero.
geometry.rasterizationNote: SVG records continuous geometry; PNG uses pixel-center split and preserves existing lower-circle alpha exactly.

intendedUsage.clippingId: Actual ArtMesh ID of HeadOpeningMask, not this display name
intendedUsage.maskParent: Root stationary, outside BodyRise and HeadGroup
intendedUsage.irisClips: Keep each existing Eye Opening mask; do not append HeadOpeningMask to iris clip ID lists.

hands.name: HandOpeningMask
hands.pixelPositionConvention: pixel centers x+0.5,y+0.5; all alpha>0 pixels, including antialias edges

limitations: Mask must remain root-stationary; moving it with the head defeats the lower opening.
PSD does not store Cubism Offscreen drawing or Clipping ID configuration. HeadGroup must render to offscreen, then be clipped by this new mask in Cubism.
The entire upper half-plane is allowed intentionally; ears and ahoge can extend outside the upper circle. Lower-half visibility stays inside the original circle.
The neutral PNG is unchanged raw PSD compositing, not a preview of configured Offscreen clipping or a validated hiding motion.

Hands remain outside HeadGroup and require their own HandOpeningMask ClipIDs. Neutral alpha is preserved; actual Reach/BodyRise shapes must still be checked for full concealment at zero. Existing eye/body/neck quality limitations are not resolved by these masks.
